name: vahid-animated-cv
description: Vahid Faraji's 60-second animated CV, made with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run audio && remotion render src/index.ts AnimatedCV out/vahid-cv-60s.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=22
scripts.render:web: ffmpeg -y -i out/vahid-cv-60s.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 25 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 128k ../site/assets/video/vahid-cv-60s.mp4
